scope: Determine live runtime entry chain vs vestigial/dead code, and whether the browser chain is intact.

critical_finding.title: PresentationEngine not loaded in browser -> live generate() returns EmptySet silently
detail: practice.html <script> tags (161-203) do NOT load shared/presentation-engine.js.
shared/presentation-engine.js uses CommonJS module.exports and NEVER registers window.PresentationEngine / global.PresentationEngine (verified: 0 matches).
shared/strategy-engine.bundle.js does NOT embed PresentationEngine (grep count 0).
generation-engine.js getPresentationEngine() -> ensure(): browser branch returns global.PresentationEngine when set; else require is not a function -> returns null.
generate() (line 168) obtains PE; runPlans() line 198: 'if (!PE) return null' -> EVERY plan silently skipped.
Net effect: live UI PracticeSession.start() -> GenerationEngine.generate() resolves with questions=[] (empty), NO error thrown.
critical_finding.verdict_must_addr: This is a silent browser baseline failure (not exercised by Node-side npm test/verify which load modules via require).
